issue_context.title: Test failure: System.Net.Sockets.Tests.ConnectEap.Connect_Dns_Success
issue_context.body:
`Connect_Dns_Success` socket test is failing for the EAP case with the error of the [event handler](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/f2d51b5e15808d2c358a59f24af4fad4a9953656/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/tests/FunctionalTests/SocketTestHelper.cs#L296) being called twice.

```
System.Net.Sockets.Tests.ConnectEap.Connect_Dns_Success(listenAt: 127.0.0.1) [FAIL]
      System.InvalidOperationException : An attempt was made to transition a task to a final state when it had already completed.
      Stack Trace:
        /_/src/libraries/System.Private.CoreLib/src/System/Threading/Tasks/TaskCompletionSource_T.cs(202,0): at System.Threading.Tasks.TaskCompletionSource`1[[System.Boolean, System.Private.CoreLib, Version=5.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7cec85d7bea7798e]].SetResult(Boolean result)
        /_/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/tests/FunctionalTests/SocketTestHelper.cs(296,0): at System.Net.Sockets.Tests.SocketHelperEap.<>c__DisplayClass15_0`1[[System.Boolean, System.Private.CoreLib, Version=5.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7cec85d7bea7798e]].<InvokeAsync>b__0(Object _, SocketAsyncEventArgs e)
        /_/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/tests/FunctionalTests/SocketTestHelper.cs(303,0): at System.Net.Sockets.Tests.SocketHelperEap.InvokeAsync[Boolean](Socket s, Func`2 getResult, Func`2 invoke)
        /_/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/tests/FunctionalTests/SocketTestHelper.cs(241,0): at System.Net.Sockets.Tests.SocketHelperEap.ConnectAsync(Socket s, EndPoint endPoint)
        /_/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/tests/FunctionalTests/SocketTestHelper.cs(329,0): at System.Net.Sockets.Tests.SocketTestHelperBase`1[[System.Net.Sockets.Tests.SocketHelperEap, System.Net.Sockets.Tests, Version=5.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=cc7b13ffcd2ddd51]].ConnectAsync(Socket s, EndPoint endPoint)
        /_/src/libraries/System.Net.Sockets/tests/FunctionalTests/Connect.cs(59,0): at System.Net.Sockets.Tests.Connect`1.<Connect_Dns_Success>d__3[[System.Net.Sockets.Tests.SocketHelperEap, System.Net.Sockets.Tests, Version=5.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=cc7b13ffcd2ddd51]].MoveNext()
```

The first occurrence of this failure was on CI for PR #42919 that worked around fixing `MultipleConnectAsync` locking logic.
Failed 18 times in innerloop in the last 10h after the PR was merged.

I think the issue is that we're calling Succeed even when the operation completes synchronously, which causes us to complete it twice. Fix should be straightforward.
